subtitle: דלאלהֵ אלחאירין — The Guide of the Perplexed
author: Moses Maimonides (1138–1204)
intro: The verbs natzav and yatzav — though from two different roots, one in meaning — are equivocal: they signify standing erect, and they signify being firm and enduring. Of God only the second applies: 'and behold, the Lord stood upon it' (Gen 28:13) means He is firm and abiding atop Jacob's ladder, whose foot is on earth and whose top reaches heaven — the prophets ascending and descending it. Hover a phrase to see its English light up; tap any word for a gloss; dotted words are key terms.

terms.gloss: to stand; to be set firm (Hebrew נִצָּב / יִצָּב)
terms.note: Two distinct roots that share one meaning across all their conjugations. The noun is equivocal: (1) standing up and being erect, (2) being firm and enduring.
The sense in which 'standing' is used of God: firm and abiding, as in 'Your word stands fast in the heavens' (Ps 119:89). Never bodily erectness.
Jacob's ladder, whose one end is in heaven and whose other is on earth. The angels who ascend and descend it are the prophets; that God 'stood upon it' means He is firm and abiding at its top.

terms.gloss: the parable that is set forth
terms.note: Maimonides cautions that his word 'upon it' is said in accordance with this parable — the ladder vision — not of bodily position.

aligned.ja: אלג'ז אלאול · אלפצל אלכ'אמס עשר — נצב ויצב
aligned.en: Part One · Chapter Fifteen — Natzav & Yatzav

aligned.ja: נצב או יצב — ואן אכ'תלפת אלאצלאן פאלמעני ואחד, כמא עלמת פי ג'מיע תצאריפהמא. והד'א אלאסם משתרך: קד יכון במעני אלקיאם ואלאנתצאב — ותתצב אחותו מרחוק, יתיצבו מלכי ארץ, יצאו נצבים.
aligned.en: Natzav or yatzav — though the two roots differ, the meaning is one, as you know from all their conjugations. This noun is equivocal: it may bear the sense of standing up and being erect — 'and his sister stood afar off' (Exod 2:4); 'the kings of the earth set themselves' (Ps 2:2); 'they came out and stood' (Num 16:27).

pairs.en: Natzav or yatzav
though the two roots differ, the meaning is one
as you know from all their conjugations

aligned.ja: ויכון במעני אלת'באת ואלדואם — דברך נצב בשמים, יעני ת'אבת באק.
aligned.en: And it bears the sense of fixity and permanence — 'Your word stands fast in the heavens' (Ps 119:89), meaning firm and abiding.

pairs.en: And it bears the sense of fixity and permanence
Your word stands fast in the heavens
meaning firm and abiding

aligned.ja: וכל מא ג'א מן הד'א אלאסם פי חק אלבארי פהו מן הד'א אלמעני — והנה י״י נצב עליו — ת'אבת באק עליה, אעני עלי אלסלם אלד'י טרפה אלאול פי אלסמא וטרפה אלאכ'ר פי אלארץ', ופיה יתסלק.
aligned.en: And every instance of this noun that comes regarding the Creator is of this sense — 'and behold, the Lord stood above it' (Gen 28:13): firm and abiding upon it, I mean upon the ladder whose one end is in heaven and whose other end is on the earth, and upon which one climbs.

and behold, the Lord stood above it
firm and abiding upon it
I mean upon the ladder

pairs.ja: אלד'י טרפה אלאול פי אלסמא וטרפה אלאכ'ר פי אלארץ'
pairs.en: whose one end is in heaven and whose other end is on the earth
and upon which one climbs

aligned.ja: ויטלע כל מן יטלע חתי ידרך מן עליה צ'רורה, אד' הו ת'אבת באק עלי ראס אלסלם. ובין הו אן קולי הנא עליה הו עלי חסב הד'א אלמת'ל אלמצ'רוב.
aligned.en: And everyone who ascends climbs up until he necessarily apprehends Him who is above it — for He is firm and abiding at the top of the ladder. It is plain that my saying here 'above it' is in accordance with this parable that is set forth.

aligned.ja: ומלאכי אלהים אלאנביא, אלד'ין קיל פיהם בביאן: וישלח מלאך, ויעל מלאך י״י מן הגלגל אל הבוכים. ומא אחכם קולה עולים ויורדים — אלעליה קבל אלירידה.
aligned.en: And the 'angels of God' are the prophets, of whom it is said plainly: 'and He sent an angel' (Num 20:16); 'and an angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim' (Judg 2:1). And how apt is His saying 'ascending and descending' (Gen 28:12) — the ascent before the descent.

pairs.en: And the 'angels of God' are the prophets
of whom it is said plainly
and He sent an angel

pairs.ja: ויעל מלאך י״י מן הגלגל אל הבוכים
pairs.en: and an angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim
And how apt is His saying 'ascending and descending'
the ascent before the descent

aligned.ja: לאן בעד אלעליה ואלוצול אלי דרג' מעלומה מן אלסלם, אלנזול במא תלקי מן אלאמר לתדביר אהל אלארץ' ותעלימהם, אלד'י ען ד'לך יכני באלירידה כמא בינא.
aligned.en: For after the ascent and the attainment of a certain rung of the ladder comes the descent, with what one has received of the command — to govern the people of the earth and to instruct them; and this is what is figured by 'descending,' as we have explained.

pairs.ja: לאן בעד אלעליה ואלוצול אלי דרג' מעלומה מן אלסלם
pairs.en: For after the ascent and the attainment of a certain rung of the ladder

pairs.ja: אלד'י ען ד'לך יכני באלירידה כמא בינא

aligned.ja: וארג'ע אלי גרצ'נא: אן נצב עליו ת'אבת דאים באק, לא אנה אנתצאב ג'סם. ומן הד'א אלמעני: ונצבת על הצור.
aligned.en: And I return to our purpose: that 'stood above it' means firm, lasting, and abiding — not the standing-erect of a body. And of this sense is: 'and you shall stand upon the rock' (Exod 33:21).

pairs.en: And I return to our purpose

aligned.ja: פקד תבין לך אן נצב ועמד מענאהמא ואחד פי הד'א אלגרץ'. וקד קאל הנני עומד לפניך שם על הצור בחורב.
aligned.en: So it has become clear to you that natzav and ʿamad have one meaning for this purpose. And He said, 'behold, I will stand before you there upon the rock in Horeb' (Exod 17:6).
